lyrics:
[Intro: pitched-down warped voice, hazy synth, vinyl crackle]
Out of the blue
Out of the blue

[Verse 1: soft, close, slow heavy beat enters]
Road shimmer, ice-cream van
I was laughing with a drink in my hand
Then a song from a passing car
And I'm back, I'm back where you are

[Chorus: falsetto on top, warped synths, deep bass]
Cold snap in July, out of the blue
Sunburn and a shiver, that's you
Everybody's swimming and I'm wearing your sweater

Cold snap in July

[Verse 2: soft, a little heavier]
You'd want me happy, I can hear you say it
I've got the summer and I don't know how to play it
Garden full of people, table full of food
And a draught only I walk through

[Chorus: falsetto on top, warped synths, deep bass]

Sunburn and a shiver, that's you
Everybody's swimming and I'm wearing your sweater
Can't make it warmer, can't make it better
Cold snap in July

[Bridge: beat drops out, voice and guitar, tape wobble]
It passes
It always passes
I let it stay a while
I let it

[Final Chorus: full, extra harmonies, guitar line]
Cold snap in July, out of the blue
Sunburn and a shiver, that's you
Everybody's swimming and I'm wearing your sweater
